papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.brief: 构建面向具体部署的自主优化循环，用成本模型定位性能缺口，并行智能体探索并整合有效方案；逐词核验防止奖励作弊，结构化记忆支持跨轮次与部署复用。
papers.tldr: 自主智能体按部署探索推测解码优化，无需训练或质量损失即可显著提速。
papers.what_it_is: 构建面向具体部署的自主优化循环，用成本模型定位性能缺口，并行智能体探索并整合有效方案；逐词核验防止奖励作弊，结构化记忆支持跨轮次与部署复用。
key_points: 发现无损12位权重格式、树验证及两级验证
覆盖4个目标模型、3个草稿模型、2种GPU和5个基准
相对自回归解码，单请求达10.87倍、批处理达3.93倍
papers.why_notable: 将算法发现与系统调优纳入可验证的自主闭环，针对部署差异寻找性能空间，展示智能体优化真实推理系统的潜力。
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.

papers.abstract: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.

papers.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
papers.brief: 提出智能体运行框架的质量与成本联合优化方法。用贝叶斯自助法估计帕累托支持度，保留任一维度可信改进的候选，避免部署偏好过早截断优化路径。

ClawMark质量70.86%→81.35%，成本降至$1.01

papers.abstract: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
papers.brief: 这是一个基于归一化Transformer的循环语言模型，通过反复执行共享模块调节推理计算量，并以难度感知课程让复杂提示使用更深循环。
papers.tldr: 通过潜空间循环实现弹性推理深度，四十亿参数模型兼顾准确率与生成效率。
papers.what_it_is: 这是一个基于归一化Transformer的循环语言模型，通过反复执行共享模块调节推理计算量，并以难度感知课程让复杂提示使用更深循环。

仅缓存最后一轮KV，四轮时智能体生成词元减少1.3—2.5倍
papers.why_notable: 将额外推理计算投入潜空间而非拉长输出，同一检查点即可适配不同预算；循环不增加KV缓存规模，为小模型扩展推理能力提供实用路径。
papers.abstract: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.

papers.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
papers.brief: LoCo从模型自身轨迹中识别过度思考状态，固定推理前缀并生成经验证的短续写，再用状态条件偏好对进行DPO训练，学习继续推理或结束作答。
papers.tldr: 通过局部偏好学习判断何时停止推理，在保持准确率的同时压缩输出长度。
papers.what_it_is: LoCo从模型自身轨迹中识别过度思考状态，固定推理前缀并生成经验证的短续写，再用状态条件偏好对进行DPO训练，学习继续推理或结束作答。
key_points: 固定推理前缀，以状态条件偏好对训练DPO

仅用数学训练，代码输出缩短23.4%—36.3%
papers.why_notable: 将压缩目标从整条轨迹缩短转向局部停止决策，改善准确率与效率的权衡；数学训练还能迁移到代码生成。
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.

papers.abstract: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover. However, new domains rarely provide large amounts of expert-created training data or reliable supervisory signals for further training. We introduce Recursa, a foundation model system that adapts to new domains by learning from its own experience without human experts or a stronger teacher model. Recursa uses a knowledge repository to store what it learns: domain-specific skills and instructions on when to apply them, along with memories of past task experiences and reflections on what to improve. Recursa bootstraps the repository from domain materials and then refines it through recursive self-improvement. It uses parallel learners to execute tasks and synthesize local improvements, then validates and merges the improvements into the knowledge repository. On Harvey LAB's Firm Knowledge benchmark, Recursa raises the all-pass rate on held-out test tasks from 30.0% to 55.0% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and from 35.0% to 46.0% with Qwen3.8-Flash.

papers.abstract: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.

papers.what_it_is: 报告梳理 Kling 多代系统的实践，以共享多模态模型 Kling-MLLM 支撑各模块，分析描述标注、提示增强、文本编码、奖励建模和自动评估如何共同影响生成质量。

papers.abstract: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

papers.abstract: Trajectory-level GRPO is a common approach for training multi-step GUI agents, but repeatedly rolling out complete trajectories from the task root can be inefficient: task-level rewards provide coarse supervision over which intermediate decisions require improvement, while already-mastered prefixes are repeatedly re-executed before reaching difficult states. We introduce a two-stage adaptive training framework that jointly addresses where to learn and how far to roll out. We first construct reusable intermediate checkpoints from successful expert trajectories and select informative pivots using action disagreement, which measures uncertainty directly from sampled GUI actions. Stage I performs one-step RL at these pivots to improve uncertain local decisions. Stage II then progressively expands policy responsibility through adaptive Local, Suffix, and Root training according to task progress. Recoverable checkpoints enable repeated training from intermediate states without replaying the preceding trajectory. Across MobileGym and CUA-Gym-Hub, our method reduces environment interaction by 56-61% relative to Vanilla GRPO while improving task performance, demonstrating that jointly allocating training across states and rollout ranges can substantially improve GUI-agent RL efficiency.

papers.why_notable: 将模型选择与行动策略选择纳入同一理论和实证框架，表明通用系统可通过能力编排改善质量与效率，而不必只依赖单个更强模型。
papers.abstract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.

papers.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.brief: ToolSpace先从真实调用轨迹提取依赖并聚类工具图，再按需合成数据库；通过带回滚的状态感知随机游走生成任务，仅保留断言检查与回放成功的样本。
papers.tldr: 从真实工具执行轨迹构建可回放环境与长链任务，提升智能体跨环境工具使用能力。
papers.what_it_is: ToolSpace先从真实调用轨迹提取依赖并聚类工具图，再按需合成数据库；通过带回滚的状态感知随机游走生成任务，仅保留断言检查与回放成功的样本。
key_points: 确定性规则提取数据、状态与重试依赖，构建加权工具组合图
两个Pro基准使7个前沿模型成绩最多下降38.2分
七项基准上Qwen平均分23.0→41.0，强化学习后43.2
papers.why_notable: 把环境合成锚定于真实执行依赖，减少虚构接口与不可执行组合；实验显示，扩展数据和环境规模可持续提升长程工具使用表现。
papers.abstract: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.

papers.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
papers.brief: 提出分布式实机评测框架，以统一策略服务和标准化协议连接各地机器人。通过盲测配对与等量示范微调，比较模型跨具身泛化、适应能力及任务进展。
papers.tldr: 跨地点实机评测显示，机器人策略排名随具身与微调变化，通用可靠性仍不足。
papers.what_it_is: 提出分布式实机评测框架，以统一策略服务和标准化协议连接各地机器人。通过盲测配对与等量示范微调，比较模型跨具身泛化、适应能力及任务进展。
key_points: 124个站点完成5699次配对，评测5种VLA与3种智能体
微调覆盖4种具身、20项任务，每任务统一提供100条示范
跨具身排名一致性弱：Kendall W仅0.24
papers.why_notable: 将真实环境差异纳入规模化评测，揭示零样本排名难预测微调表现；部分进展指标还能区分成功率均为零的策略。
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks reliably. After fine-tuning, GR00T N1.7 leads on SO-101 and pi0.5 leads on Franka and Bimanual-YAM. Policy rankings show weak agreement across embodiment-specific task suites (Kendall W = 0.24). Open Track rankings poorly predict relative performance after fine-tuning, with substantial rank reversals on all three embodiments shared between tracks. Measuring partial progress reveals differences that task success alone misses. On the G1 Humanoid, no policy completes any of the five tasks, yet average progress ranges from 13.3% to 23.2% across policies. Open Track rankings stabilize as trials accumulate, and active matchmaking achieves comparable ranking agreement with substantially fewer physical trials than uniform sampling. These results show how distributed physical evaluation can reveal where robot policies generalize, how well they adapt to new tasks, and how far they progress on tasks they fail to complete.

papers.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
papers.brief: DreamX将预训练视频扩散模型改造为潜动作学习器，从时空特征中提取紧凑动作编码，并借助生成先验分离动作动态与外观变化，构建跨形态共享动作接口。
papers.tldr: 利用视频扩散模型学习紧凑潜动作，支持跨人机形态与环境的零样本动作迁移。
papers.what_it_is: DreamX将预训练视频扩散模型改造为潜动作学习器，从时空特征中提取紧凑动作编码，并借助生成先验分离动作动态与外观变化，构建跨形态共享动作接口。
key_points: 每个潜视频帧从1200压至4个词元，实现300倍压缩
在LARY-Bench上达到潜动作模型最优表现
支持任意到任意视频迁移及跨形态零样本动作迁移
papers.why_notable: 将视频生成先验转化为可迁移的动作接口，为人类与机器人共享动作表示提供路径，同时降低视频扩散策略学习的计算成本。
papers.abstract: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by $\boldsymbol{300\times}$ ($\boldsymbol{1{,}200 \rightarrow 4}$ tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. On LARY-Bench, DreamX achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent action models. Moreover, actions encoded in one setting remain effective in another: the latent space supports any-to-any video transfer and zero-shot action transfer across diverse embodiments and environments. Furthermore, this shared interface also enables policy learning in a compact latent action space, reducing the computational cost of video-diffusion-based policies.

papers.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.brief: FactEmbed将组合查询理解与检索表示构建解耦，用目标想象任务引导分解潜变量捕捉修改后的视觉语义，再通过因子级对比学习与注意力层蒸馏优化检索。
papers.tldr: 通过分解潜变量先想象修改后的目标图像，再构建多模态检索表示。
papers.what_it_is: FactEmbed将组合查询理解与检索表示构建解耦，用目标想象任务引导分解潜变量捕捉修改后的视觉语义，再通过因子级对比学习与注意力层蒸馏优化检索。
key_points: 目标想象任务使分解潜变量对齐目标语义
因子级对比损失结合深层注意力蒸馏
单次前向生成EOS检索表示与均值池化重排表示
papers.why_notable: 其价值在于让多模态模型先解析视觉修改，再学习检索表示；在多个组合图像检索基准上超越既有方法，且重排开销很低。
papers.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.

papers.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
papers.brief: 研究构建具身智能体评测平台，以最小执行框架让模型通过原生接口自主决策，比较十个视觉语言模型在几何、空间推理、可供性、规划与操控上的表现。
papers.tldr: 千例评测揭示前沿视觉语言智能体在几何理解与机器人任务执行间仍有明显断层。
papers.what_it_is: 研究构建具身智能体评测平台，以最小执行框架让模型通过原生接口自主决策，比较十个视觉语言模型在几何、空间推理、可供性、规划与操控上的表现。
key_points: 1000例整合32个来源及168例GeoProbe
闭源模型领跑五领域，开源模型规划与操控较弱
代码修复不保证任务完成，自我复审可能推翻正确判断
papers.why_notable: 评测将感知判断与物理任务完成分开检验，揭示区域估计正确不等于动作可用，也为定位失控、目标绑定和提前终止提供依据。
papers.abstract: A robot generalist must interpret a scene, act on it, and satisfy every condition of a task. How far do frontier vision-language models (VLMs) meet these demands? We introduce Embodied Agent Arena, evaluating ten VLM agents across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. Its 1,000 cases combine 32 established sources with GeoProbe, our 168-case benchmark for camera, motion, depth, and scale estimation. A minimal harness leaves task decisions to the model through source-native interfaces. Closed-weight models lead all five domains, whereas open-weight VLMs show useful spatial reasoning but substantially lower planning and manipulation success. Beneath these averages, similar geometric errors conceal different scale and shape distortions, and valid region estimates need not identify usable action points. During execution, agents can achieve early subgoals yet lose object control, bind an action to the wrong receiving region, or stop before the required physical state holds. Additional computation does not uniformly resolve these failures: code repair can restore execution without completing the task, while self-review can reverse correct judgments. Failure costs also differ: the strongest planners concentrate failed-token expenditure in prolonged body-control tasks, whereas other models fail broadly across procedures. Matched traces show how successful recovery uses feedback to restore a missing prerequisite and advance the remaining task.

papers.title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
papers.brief: 提出多模态有状态交互数据集与基准，覆盖图像融合、编辑、世界建模和视觉推理。通过跨轮状态依赖训练模型，并分别评估状态理解与视觉实现。
papers.tldr: 用大规模多轮图文对话训练与评测模型追踪状态、保持视觉输出一致性的能力。
papers.what_it_is: 提出多模态有状态交互数据集与基准，覆盖图像融合、编辑、世界建模和视觉推理。通过跨轮状态依赖训练模型，并分别评估状态理解与视觉实现。
key_points: YANAMI-400K含40万对话、超200万图像及260万轮次
YANAMI-Bench用400组多轮对话评估状态理解与视觉实现
BAGEL微调后编辑提升10.3%，有状态交互提升13.23%
papers.why_notable: 将评测重点从独立单轮任务转向跨轮状态维护，并区分理解与视觉实现，揭示模型理解变化却难以忠实生成的能力缺口。
papers.abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. However, existing unified multimodal datasets and benchmarks remain dominated by single-turn tasks. Even in recent multi-turn datasets, many turns can be solved independently without tracking information across turns. Consequently, they provide limited supervision and evaluation for multimodal stateful interaction, which requires models to understand, maintain, update, and faithfully realize evolving dialogue states across turns. To address this gap, we introduce YANAMI, the first large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, comprising YANAMI-400K and YANAMI-Bench. YANAMI-400K contains 400K multi-turn multimodal dialogues, with more than 2M images and 2.6M dialogue turns. The dialogues span four representative scenarios: Multi-Image Fusion, Image Editing, World Modeling, and Visual Reasoning, and require models to continuously track, preserve, and revise evolving multimodal dialogue states across turns. YANAMI-Bench comprises 400 multi-turn dialogues for systematically evaluating multimodal stateful interaction. It jointly evaluates Dialogue State Understanding and Visual Realization, characterizing the gap between models' ability to understand evolving dialogue states and their ability to faithfully realize them in visual outputs. Experiments show that fine-tuning BAGEL on YANAMI-400K improves image editing, generation, and multimodal stateful interaction by 10.3%, 2.0%, and 13.23%, respectively, while preserving its general visual understanding capabilities. Evaluations on YANAMI-Bench further reveal that existing UMMs still struggle to maintain, update, and visually realize evolving multimodal dialogue states.

papers.title: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
papers.brief: Pandora根据咨询师干预更新心理与关系状态，形成主观评价并规划回应策略。独立表达规划器结合来访者原话中的语言模式，生成符合其当下理解的表达。
papers.tldr: 通过动态心理状态与独立表达规划，让心理咨询来访者模拟更贴近个人表达。
papers.what_it_is: Pandora根据咨询师干预更新心理与关系状态，形成主观评价并规划回应策略。独立表达规划器结合来访者原话中的语言模式，生成符合其当下理解的表达。
key_points: Pandora分离回应决策与个体语言表达规划
在4个数据集115个案例上对比5种基线
AI感判定率7.2%，去除表达规划后35.6%
papers.why_notable: 将来访者的表达能力与心理状态、信任变化关联，减少模拟回应过度清晰的问题，为更贴近个体的咨询模拟提供方法。
papers.abstract: Psychotherapy clients may experience distress before they can coherently describe it, and their expression changes with emotion, perceived safety, and trust. Large language model-based client simulators often rely on clinically organized case descriptions, which can encourage responses explaining the client's difficulties more clearly than their current understanding warrants. We propose Pandora, a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models how psychological experience becomes situated, individual expression. Pandora updates psychological and relational states in response to therapist interventions, constructs subjective appraisals and attributions, and plans response content and strategy. A separate expression planner combines these decisions with language patterns distilled from the client's utterances to guide linguistic realization. We evaluate Pandora against five baselines on 115 cases from four counseling and motivational interviewing datasets. It achieves the highest expression similarity and overall disclosure-alignment score among the compared systems. In a four-evaluator study of 45 matched disclosure items, Pandora receives AI-like judgments in 7.2% of ratings, compared with 43.3--67.2% for the baselines and 35.6% without expression planning. The ablation also reduces expression similarity. These results support explicit expression planning in client simulation to improve alignment with individual language patterns and reduce perceived AI-like expression in the evaluated setting.

papers.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
papers.brief: 提出面向理解、编辑及统一任务的数据策展智能体，通过全局感知、关键帧与多模态信号挖掘、元数据构建和路由生成指令样本，并用下游训练反馈调整数据分布。
papers.tldr: 从原始视频自动合成多模态指令数据，并依据训练反馈迭代优化数据分布。
papers.what_it_is: 提出面向理解、编辑及统一任务的数据策展智能体，通过全局感知、关键帧与多模态信号挖掘、元数据构建和路由生成指令样本，并用下游训练反馈调整数据分布。
key_points: 四阶段流水线完成视频筛选到指令样本合成
依据下游训练结果自主迭代数据分布
构建VidUEU-100K，含10万条跨域多任务样本
papers.why_notable: 将数据生成与训练反馈连接成闭环，不只追求样本数量，也优化质量和均衡性；基线模型微调后在多个代表性基准上获得一致提升。
papers.abstract: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data. While raw videos offer an abundant and dynamic source of visual knowledge, transforming them into precise instruction data remains highly challenging. To bridge this gap, we present VidUEU-Agent, an automated pipeline that synthesizes instruction data from raw videos for multimodal understanding, editing, and unified tasks. VidUEU-Agent follows a four-stage pipeline: it performs global perception to filter low-quality shots, mines keyframes and multimodal signals, constructs metadata and routes the metadata to synthesize instruction samples. More importantly, our agent framework can autonomously iterate the data distribution based on downstream training results, thereby optimizing data quality, balance, and training effectiveness. Scaling this pipeline, we construct VidUEU-100K, a large-scale dataset of 100K training samples spanning multiple domains and tasks, providing a robust foundation for developing comprehensive multimodal capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning baseline models on VidUEU-100K yields significant and consistent performance gains across diverse representative benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of our proposed agent framework and dataset.

papers.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.brief: Caper在快照沙箱中预执行命令，将观察到的影响整理为限长报告，交给独立审批器判断；获准则提交，拒绝则回滚并提供可操作的理由。
papers.tldr: Caper通过沙箱预执行观察命令后果，降低自主编程智能体的有害操作率。
papers.what_it_is: Caper在快照沙箱中预执行命令，将观察到的影响整理为限长报告，交给独立审批器判断；获准则提交，拒绝则回滚并提供可操作的理由。
key_points: 快照沙箱预执行，以实际后果而非命令文本审批
SABER有害结果率6.7%，六个对照均≥14.8%
YoloFS-Ext有害率7.8%，安全配对任务误拦1.0%
papers.why_notable: 它将审批依据从命令表面转向实际执行后果，能识别藏在工具内部的危险行为，同时保持较低的安全任务误拦率。
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. Existing approvers, from rule-based checkers to guardrail models and deployed permission classifiers, base their decisions on the text of the request and command. Yet a command's behavior depends on the code it invokes and the state of the workspace, and systems that observe file changes leave the assessment to the agent or a human after execution. We present Caper, a consequence-aware approval mechanism that pre-executes each command in a snapshotted sandbox, provides an independent approver with a bounded report of its observed effects, commits allowed commands, and rolls back blocked ones with a reason the agent can act on. Compared with six existing systems, Caper achieves the lowest harmful-outcome rate on SABER (6.7% versus at least 14.8%) and YoloFS-Ext, a benchmark we build in which harmful behavior is hidden inside invoked tools (7.8% versus at least 35.3%), while blocking 1.0% of the safe twins of the dangerous tasks in YoloFS-Ext.

papers.title: Autonomous agents for electricity-system planning
papers.brief: 提出自主智能体电力规划框架，迭代设计并优化投资与调度，在五个电力系统的四十条轨迹中均找到满足物理约束和年度碳预算的方案。
papers.tldr: 提出自主智能体电力规划框架，迭代设计并优化投资与调度，在五个电力系统的四十条轨迹中均找到满足物理约束和年度碳预算的方案。
papers.abstract: Planning electricity systems requires repeated decisions that connect regional resources, investment, operation and network constraints. Here we present an autonomous planning framework that carries prepared regional scenarios through proposal, numerical evaluation, feedback interpretation, redesign and final plan selection. Agents propose investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions, interpret numerical feedback, and decide how to revise designs and when to stop. The framework automatically executes annual investment-and-dispatch optimization and representative-feeder verification, applies fixed acceptance criteria and retains the lowest-cost accepted candidate. We evaluate forty carbon-constrained trajectories across ten system-year scenarios in five electricity systems and four countries, using two model deployments and single- and multi-agent architectures. All forty retain candidates satisfying the implemented physical and fixed annual operational carbon-budget checks. Twenty-eight of forty matched reference designs exceed the new scenario ceilings. A separate archive of ninety-six trajectories under a common 1,000 Mt annual ceiling provides matched references and broader regional coverage. The results demonstrate autonomous planning under explicit emissions constraints using public regional data and published institutional demand outlooks.
