papers.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
papers.brief: EvoTeam以执行经验驱动协作演化，维护可复用团队库，按任务选择或创建团队。团队使用专属交互规则，协作经验在兼容情境内积累，个体技能则可跨团队复用。
papers.tldr: 通过联合演化团队结构、交互规则与智能体技能，改善异构任务中的多智能体协作。
papers.what_it_is: EvoTeam以执行经验驱动协作演化，维护可复用团队库，按任务选择或创建团队。团队使用专属交互规则，协作经验在兼容情境内积累，个体技能则可跨团队复用。
key_points: 联合演化团队组织、交互规则和个体技能
可复用团队库支持团队选择与创建
在4个基准上验证有效性，代码已开源
papers.why_notable: 将优化重心从单个智能体转向团队协作，避免不同团队机械共用交互规则，为异构任务下的经验积累与技能复用提供框架。
papers.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration. Recent studies have therefore extended evolution to the collaboration level, using collective execution experience to adjust team organization, and inter-agent interactions. Nevertheless, evolving collaboration across heterogeneous tasks remains challenging, as existing approaches often constrain team reorganization within a shared structure and reuse interaction rules across incompatible team contexts. In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience. It maintains a library of reusable teams, selecting or creating agent teams and guiding collaboration through team-specific interaction rules. Collaboration experience accumulates within compatible team contexts, while individual skills remain reusable across teams. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness. Our code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/EvoTeam.

papers.title: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
papers.brief: 构建同仓库未完成任务交错执行的基准，以配对会话比较连续执行与切换后恢复的效果；另用插件筛选任务相关历史、维护状态摘要，改善恢复表现。
papers.tldr: 编码智能体切换未完成任务后成功率下降，筛选历史与状态摘要可改善任务恢复。
papers.what_it_is: 构建同仓库未完成任务交错执行的基准，以配对会话比较连续执行与切换后恢复的效果；另用插件筛选任务相关历史、维护状态摘要，改善恢复表现。
key_points: Switch-SWE含19个Python仓库的200项任务、400组会话规格
7个编码智能体切换后平均解决率下降11.5个百分点
上下文管理插件使OpenCode完成率提升5.5至15.5个百分点
papers.why_notable: 将评测从单次修复扩展到多任务恢复，量化需求混淆与状态丢失的代价，并展示轻量上下文管理的改善潜力。
papers.abstract: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion. As coding agents take on repository-level development, they need to recover an earlier task's requirements and partial progress after intervening work. Existing repository-level benchmarks typically score one issue-to-patch episode and do not directly measure whether an agent can resume a task after advancing other unfinished work in the same repository. We introduce \textbf{\ourmethod}, a benchmark for focus-task resumption in sessions that interleave unfinished tasks drawn from the same source repository, with a persistent checkout for each task. Each focus task is evaluated in matched uninterrupted and switched sessions with identical focus requirements and executable verifiers. The switched session interleaves ordered stages from other unfinished tasks in the same repository, while only the final focus patch is scored. \ourmethod~contains 200 focus tasks from 19 Python repositories, reconstructed from issue, pull-request, and review histories and rendered as 400 matched session specifications. Across 7 coding agents, interleaved unfinished work produces an average focus-task resolution gap of 11.5 percentage points, ranging from 6.0 to 15.0 percentage points. Trajectory analysis identifies cross-task requirement confusion and loss of task state as recurrent resumption behaviors. We introduce a plug-in context-management module that selects task-relevant history and maintains concise task-state summaries. On OpenCode, the module improves focus-task completion under same-repository task switching by 5.5 to 15.5 percentage points across the evaluated models. Code is available at github.com/Miraclecsc/Switch-SWE.

papers.title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
papers.brief: MoLRSI联合优化工作流与模型架构，并保留跨任务记忆。它利用流程表现、改进结果和执行反馈，同时更新分子搜索流程与开发这些流程的策略。
papers.tldr: 通过跨任务记忆递归改进分子发现流程，在抗生素筛选与结合物设计中获实验验证。
papers.what_it_is: MoLRSI联合优化工作流与模型架构，并保留跨任务记忆。它利用流程表现、改进结果和执行反馈，同时更新分子搜索流程与开发这些流程的策略。
key_points: 跨任务记忆驱动工作流、模型架构及搜索策略递归优化
抗生素实验命中率15.9%，专家流程为8.7%
肽-MHC结合物设计获得8个实验验证命中
papers.why_notable: 价值在于不仅自动执行设计，还能用经验改进设计流程的开发策略；两类实验任务显示其可兼顾活性、安全性或特异性等竞争目标。
papers.abstract: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.

papers.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
papers.brief: 提出MTA-OPSD，从不同参考信息条件下的候选教师构建教师池，让模型在同一回答内为每个词元自适应选择教师，而非整段共用固定监督。
papers.tldr: 让每个词元自适应选择教师，为大模型数学推理提供更细粒度的蒸馏监督。
papers.what_it_is: 提出MTA-OPSD，从不同参考信息条件下的候选教师构建教师池，让模型在同一回答内为每个词元自适应选择教师，而非整段共用固定监督。
key_points: 教师干预实验验证同一回答内词元的教师偏好不同
通过多数投票与KL准则识别词元偏好的教师
Qwen3数学推理实验较基座平均增益最高达+5.9
papers.why_notable: 将自蒸馏的教师适配从回答级推进到词元级，并在数学推理中持续优于已有方法，表明监督粒度本身是后训练的重要设计变量。
papers.abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.

papers.title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
papers.brief: LOLPlay在原生英雄联盟中设置英雄专属任务，让智能体通过截图和鼠标键盘操作交互，并用自动初始化与可执行子目标检查区分局部进展和完整成功。
papers.tldr: 实时游戏评测表明，增加推理投入未提升视觉智能体表现，及时行动同样关键。
papers.what_it_is: LOLPlay在原生英雄联盟中设置英雄专属任务，让智能体通过截图和鼠标键盘操作交互，并用自动初始化与可执行子目标检查区分局部进展和完整成功。
key_points: 36项英雄专属任务，配套82项可执行子目标检查
324次评测覆盖3个模型及3档推理投入
Astra任务成功率最高25.0%，高推理投入均无增益
papers.why_notable: 它将视觉智能体评测推进到持续变化的真实游戏环境，揭示推理耗时与交互机会的冲突，为兼顾视觉理解和行动时效提供测试场。
papers.abstract: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native \emph{League of Legends} with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse--keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0\% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3\% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. Trajectories reveal incomplete subgoal composition and actions executing after the observed scene changes, motivating agents that combine visual reasoning with timely action.

papers.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
papers.brief: FlowTranslator先用OCR识别文字、由大语言模型生成翻译提示，再驱动文生图模型编辑图像；通过两种轨迹控制改善译文生成，无需配对图像训练。
papers.tldr: 无需任务训练，通过流式编辑替换图中文字译文，并保留周围视觉内容。
papers.what_it_is: FlowTranslator先用OCR识别文字、由大语言模型生成翻译提示，再驱动文生图模型编辑图像；通过两种轨迹控制改善译文生成，无需配对图像训练。
key_points: RCR早期解耦文字区噪声，CE中期放大编辑位移
PRIM上BLEU为20.6、COMET为57.2
ScenePair整图译中文精确匹配率40.1%
papers.why_notable: 将文生图模型的多语言能力迁移到完整图像翻译，减少对配对训练数据的依赖，并在报告评测中超越训练式基线及现有编辑系统。
papers.abstract: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.

papers.title: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
papers.brief: RoboTryOn借鉴虚拟试穿，用参考图指定的机器人替换视频中的人，保留任务与场景；结合手部骨架引导生成和含深度特征的逆动力学模型，产出带动作标签的训练数据。
papers.tldr: 将人类操作视频转为机器人示范，无需新任务真机演示即可提升双手操作能力。
papers.what_it_is: RoboTryOn借鉴虚拟试穿，用参考图指定的机器人替换视频中的人，保留任务与场景；结合手部骨架引导生成和含深度特征的逆动力学模型，产出带动作标签的训练数据。
key_points: 自回归转换关键帧，以人手骨架引导视频合成
含深度特征的逆动力学模型推断动作标签
新任务平均成功率由2%升至60%，采集成本约为遥操作的三分之一
papers.why_notable: 为高自由度机器人提供可扩展的人类视频示范来源，在无需新任务真机演示的条件下提升操作表现，并以更低成本达到遥操作数据训练的水平。
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models have shown remarkable performance in robot control, yet adapting them to a new task still relies heavily on teleoperated demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. To address this limitation, we propose RoboTryOn, which treats human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on: try-on keeps the person and swaps the garment, RoboTryOn keeps the demonstrated motion and swaps the human for the robot. Specifically, RoboTryOn converts a human video into a video of the target robot specified by a reference image, while preserving the original task, objects, and background. To maintain visual consistency, we translate selected keyframes autoregressively and use them to guide video synthesis with motion conditioned on the human hand skeleton. Additionally, we use an inverse dynamics model (IDM) that incorporates depth features to infer action labels from synthesized videos for policy learning. Our experiments across multiple humanoid embodiments show that policies trained with our synthetic data improve the average success rate on novel tasks, including challenging bimanual manipulation, from 2% to 60%, without any real robot demonstration of those tasks. Moreover, training with our synthetic data matches the performance of policies trained solely on teleoperated demonstrations at approximately a third of the collection cost, demonstrating the cost efficiency of our approach.

papers.title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
papers.brief: PrimeSim从预训练视频生成器出发，通过渐进式中间训练与后训练构建动作条件模拟器，结合统一动作表示、多视角注意力和分层记忆，实现跨机器人长程仿真。
papers.tldr: 以跨平台机器人演示训练通用世界模拟器，兼顾动作忠实、多视角一致与长程稳定。
papers.what_it_is: PrimeSim从预训练视频生成器出发，通过渐进式中间训练与后训练构建动作条件模拟器，结合统一动作表示、多视角注意力和分层记忆，实现跨机器人长程仿真。
key_points: 中间训练覆盖22种平台、30110小时机器人演示
双路径条件对齐动作与帧，视角感知交错注意力融合多视角
快视频慢记忆后训练支持自回归仿真，速度达10.1 FPS
papers.why_notable: 在五项WorldSimProbe套件中领先四项，且能支撑GRPO策略优化，展示仿真训练价值；但细粒度局部校准仍落后。
papers.abstract: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.

papers.title: Can AI Reviewers See Your Efforts to Improve Your Paper? A Large-Scale Study of Paper Revision Trajectories
papers.brief: 研究用论文修订轨迹检验AI审稿能否识别质量提升。通过自动标注修订维度、独立评估各版本，并加入用户意见，分析评分与改进的一致性。
papers.tldr: 大规模研究发现，AI审稿评分难以稳定识别实质改进，且易受用户负面意见影响。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用论文修订轨迹检验AI审稿能否识别质量提升。通过自动标注修订维度、独立评估各版本，并加入用户意见，分析评分与改进的一致性。
key_points: PaperTrajectory-2026含6959条轨迹，覆盖5个AI会议、14个修订维度。
8个AI审稿器对多数重大改进维持原分，评分变化方向一致性弱。
简短负面用户意见可抹去甚至逆转修订带来的中性评分优势。
papers.why_notable: 研究揭示AI审稿对实质修订的识别不足及对用户立场的敏感性，为构建证据关联更强、评分更稳定的评审机制提供依据。
papers.abstract: AI reviewers are increasingly used to assess scientific manuscripts, yet it remains unclear whether their judgments reflect the improvements authors make through revision. We investigate this question using PaperTrajectory-2026, the 2026 release of PaperTrajectory, a dataset of 6,959 paper trajectories across five AI conferences, with automatic annotations of changes along 14 dimensions and separate judgments of overall quality. The annotations show that major improvements emphasize empirical evidence and framing, while later revisions tend toward incremental improvement. Using independent assessments of manuscript versions from eight AI reviewers, we examine whether annotated major improvements receive higher scores, which revision dimensions are associated with score changes, and whether user opinions can outweigh observed revision gains. Every reviewer leaves scores unchanged on most major improvements, and agreement on the direction of score changes is weak. Revision dimensions show some reviewer-specific associations with score increases, but provide limited predictive discrimination and no consistent guide across reviewers. Even when a revision earns a higher neutral score, a brief negative user opinion can erase or reverse that advantage, with substantial variation across reviewers. These findings show that substantive revisions are not consistently reflected in review scores and that observed scoring gains can be vulnerable to user framing, motivating assessments that connect manuscript evidence to overall judgments and remain stable when no scientific evidence changes.

papers.title: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
papers.brief: 研究定位了门控序列模型中近零词嵌入引发的训练停滞：门控读出失效后，多层归一化放大梯度并使裁剪溢出。提出分组裁剪与门控下限两种修复。
papers.tldr: 近零词嵌入可使门控模型梯度溢出并丢失更新，分组裁剪与门控下限能修复
papers.what_it_is: 研究定位了门控序列模型中近零词嵌入引发的训练停滞：门控读出失效后，多层归一化放大梯度并使裁剪溢出。提出分组裁剪与门控下限两种修复。
key_points: 调查291个仓库，未绑定门控及混合检查点中52.6%存在近零嵌入
GroupClip消除更新丢失，并在一步内修复触发行
GateFloor将近零输入梯度降低28个数量级，困惑度保持相当
papers.why_notable: 揭示了数值异常如何静默变成训练更新丢失，实测持续预训练约20%的步骤受影响；修复方案兼顾已发布模型与预训练。
papers.abstract: Among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20/38) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below $10^{-6}$, compared with 0% of weight-tied models. Such near-zero rows can arise during pretraining when unseen rare or template tokens receive zero input gradients while AdamW weight decay shrinks untied embeddings. In tested Transformer configurations, non-initial positions or a BOS token prevent this failure mode. In gated sequence models (Mamba, Gated DeltaNet, xLSTM), a near-zero token can amplify input-embedding gradients by more than 30 orders of magnitude (up to 35). At zero input, current-token readout factors (SiLU gates or linear queries) vanish, suppressing historical-state readout. Residual RMS values can then fall below the square root of the RMSNorm floor across consecutive layers, causing Pre-RMSNorm to amplify backward gradients by up to $10^3$ per layer. When a gradient entry exceeds $1.84 \times 10^{19}$, FP32 global-norm clipping in PyTorch, Hugging Face Trainer, and FSDP2 can overflow to infinity and zero the current batch's gradients. In Telugu continual pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, this discards updates on approximately 20% of steps and leaves triggered rows frozen. We propose two remedies. For released checkpoints, GroupClip decouples input-embedding clipping using a 64-bit or rescaled norm; its rescaled implementation eliminates update loss and heals triggered rows in one step with negligible measured end-to-end overhead. For pretraining, GateFloor ($\mathrm{SiLU}(z) + δ$, $δ\in [0.01, 0.1]$) keeps the gate positive at zero input, reducing near-zero gradients by 28 orders of magnitude in experiments up to 370M parameters, with perplexity comparable to the baseline.

papers.title: Is Your Long-Horizon Benchmark Really Deep? Measuring and Synthesizing Depth in Terminal Tasks
papers.brief: 研究将终端任务拆为操作量与顺序交互深度，以能成功完成任务的最小轮数上限估计深度。DEPTH让生成智能体在真实环境中逐段执行、续写任务。
papers.tldr: 用不可并行的交互深度衡量终端任务，揭示现有合成基准偏浅并生成更深任务。
papers.what_it_is: 研究将终端任务拆为操作量与顺序交互深度，以能成功完成任务的最小轮数上限估计深度。DEPTH让生成智能体在真实环境中逐段执行、续写任务。
key_points: 审计6个数据集734项任务，已解合成任务94%三轮内通过
DEPTH生成105项任务，深度与操作量均超被审计数据集
6个模型通过率均不足50%；微调Qwen3-8B提升两项基准表现
papers.why_notable: 把任务本身的顺序依赖与模型交互习惯区分开，提供更可靠的长程能力评估尺度，也展示深任务合成可用于提升终端智能体。
papers.abstract: Long-horizon terminal tasks are used to evaluate and train agents. Human-curated datasets are scarce, so many synthesis methods have emerged. They usually measure the length of a task by the turns a model needs to pass it, and its difficulty by labels the LLM sets during generation. We find, however, that the turn count largely reflects the habits of the model, not only the demands of the task, and that the labels barely track how often models pass. We describe a terminal task by its work, the number of operations it requires, and its depth, the number of turns that must happen in sequence because the commands of each turn can only be chosen after reading the output of the previous one. Estimating depth as the smallest turn cap, stated to the agent, under which the task passes, we audit 734 tasks from six existing datasets. Synthesis has mostly added work, not depth: 94% of the solved synthetic tasks pass within three turns, yet depth, unlike the turn count, predicts difficulty beyond work. We propose DEPTH, in which a generation agent writes each task one segment at a time in a real software environment, carrying out each segment before writing it and starting the next from the state it leaves. Our 105 tasks exceed every audited dataset in depth and work, and none of six current models passes half of them. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on runs from these tasks improves it on two terminal benchmarks.

papers.title: BEND 2.0: Benchmarking the Capabilities Needed to Design DNA
papers.brief: BEND 2.0基于实验数据评估DNA变更效应预测及序列设计能力，比较模型原生输出、冻结表征的线性读出与功能后训练，检验预测能否有效指导设计。
papers.tldr: 新基准检验基因组模型指导DNA设计的能力，揭示预测准确不等于设计可靠。
papers.what_it_is: BEND 2.0基于实验数据评估DNA变更效应预测及序列设计能力，比较模型原生输出、冻结表征的线性读出与功能后训练，检验预测能否有效指导设计。
key_points: 基于5个实验数据集构建8项预测与设计任务
冻结表征的线性读出可追平或超越原生输出
组合突变效应预测准确，不代表突变交互预测准确
papers.why_notable: 将评测从效应预测推进到设计实用性：模型能减少候选筛选量，但情境特异性与多细胞目标仍暴露明显短板。
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly used to propose DNA sequences and edits. But successful design requires capabilities that current benchmarks do not measure. Here we introduce BEND 2.0 (BENchmark for DNA language models), which tests how well models predict the effects of DNA changes and whether these predictions can guide sequence design. Across eight tasks built on five experimental datasets, we find that model choice and how representations are accessed both affect performance. Linear readouts fitted to frozen representations can match or exceed models' native outputs, and functional post-training substantially improves the models' capabilities. Linear readouts transfer well across experimental assays and genes, suggesting that models capture functional patterns beyond the data used to fit individual predictors. At the same time, strong prediction of average effects can conceal weaker prediction of context-specific effects, and accurate prediction of combined mutation effects does not imply accurate prediction of their interactions. In design tasks, model predictions can reduce the number of candidates needed to find a desired response, but still leave substantial room for better design choices, particularly for context-specific and multi-cell objectives. Our benchmark reveals that genomic models now display signs of general utility but have yet to saturate on performance in even simple tasks.

papers.title: Enhancing Stock Market Information Retrieval with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.brief: 构建面向股票市场信息的RAG问答系统，将检索结果与生成模型结合，以提升回答的准确性和相关性。通过参考文本匹配指标与延迟测试评估效果。
papers.tldr: 将检索增强生成用于股市问答，在百条查询上评估文本匹配度与响应速度。
papers.what_it_is: 构建面向股票市场信息的RAG问答系统，将检索结果与生成模型结合，以提升回答的准确性和相关性。通过参考文本匹配指标与延迟测试评估效果。
key_points: RAG结合信息检索与文本生成，回答股市相关问题
在100条查询上评估ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L
平均响应时间为1.16秒
papers.why_notable: 提供了金融信息问答的轻量应用验证，同时报告文本匹配度与响应速度；但高ROUGE分数不等同于金融事实准确。
papers.abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has been widely applied in financial domains, enabling automated analysis and retrieval of stock market information. However, traditional NLP-based systems often struggle with maintaining contextual accuracy and generating relevant responses in dynamic financial environments. To address these challenges, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have emerged as a powerful solution, combining retrieval-based methods with generative capabilities to enhance response quality. In this study, we present a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system designed to generate responses related to stock market information. The system integrates retrieval-based and generative approaches to enhance the accuracy and relevance of financial text generation. To evaluate its effectiveness, we employ the ROUGE metric, specifically ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L, to measure lexical and structural similarity between generated and reference texts. Experimental results on a dataset of 100 stock market-related queries demonstrate high ROUGE scores, indicating strong alignment with reference documents. Additionally, we assess latency to evaluate the system responsiveness, achieving an average response time of 1.16 seconds. These findings confirm that our RAG model is capable of providing accurate and timely stock market insights, making it a promising approach for financial information retrieval.

papers.title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.brief: 研究如何让统一多模态模型同时停止生成和识别目标概念，并保留其他能力。构建跨路径诊断基准UUBench，提出联合遗忘方法UniForget。
papers.tldr: 统一多模态模型的概念遗忘需兼顾生成与理解，单路径编辑难以奏效。
papers.what_it_is: 研究如何让统一多模态模型同时停止生成和识别目标概念，并保留其他能力。构建跨路径诊断基准UUBench，提出联合遗忘方法UniForget。
key_points: UUBench覆盖30个目标概念及60个语义邻近概念
单路径遗忘方法及其直接组合均难实现充分联合遗忘
UniForget在两款7B模型上达80.0%和92.7%联合遗忘率
papers.why_notable: 将概念遗忘的评估从单一生成或理解扩展到双路径，揭示遗忘效果与能力保留的权衡，为统一模型的安全编辑提供参照。
papers.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding, but are existing single-pathway unlearning methods sufficient to suppress target concepts across both? In this work, we study cross-pathway concept unlearning. Our goal is to prevent a model from both generating images of a target concept and identifying it in input images, while preserving other capabilities. To this end, we introduce UUBench, a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 target concepts and 60 semantically related neighboring concepts. Experiments on representative UMMs show that the evaluated single-pathway methods achieve limited joint forgetting: generation-side editors strongly suppress target generation but yield limited forgetting in visual understanding, while understanding-side baselines struggle to achieve substantial forgetting even in their own pathway. Their direct composition also yields limited joint forgetting. We therefore propose UniForget, achieving joint forgetting rates of 80.0% on BAGEL-7B-MoT and 92.7% on Janus-Pro-7B, outperforming representative baselines. Further analysis reveals trade-offs between joint forgetting and capability preservation.
papers.organization: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation

papers.title: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
papers.brief: 研究固定剪枝掩码，分离比较三类专家替代算子与路由语义；提出闭式低秩映射 tilted novice，并检验量化、校准域及评测任务的影响。
papers.tldr: 免训练专家剪枝不仅取决于删谁，门控尺度与替代算子也会显著改变效果。
papers.what_it_is: 研究固定剪枝掩码，分离比较三类专家替代算子与路由语义；提出闭式低秩映射 tilted novice，并检验量化、校准域及评测任务的影响。
key_points: 未按重归一化训练的路由器，重归一化损失0.8—8.5分
tilted novice在50%剪枝下提升3.45及1.37分
25%剪枝时，MoNE仅保留0—17%的代码得分
papers.why_notable: 揭示常被忽略的门控尺度足以逆转方法排名，也说明选择题成绩不能代表推理与代码能力，为可靠比较专家剪枝方法提供依据。
papers.abstract: Training-free expert pruning makes two decisions: which experts to remove, and what the layer computes when its router still selects a removed expert. Published methods change both at once. Holding the mask fixed, we compare replacement operators from three families on OLMoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight, with Granite as a fourth router, using paired, multiplicity-corrected tests. The largest effect is a choice usually left implicit: the survivors' gate scale. On routers trained without top-k renormalization, renormalizing the survivors' gates, a common implementation choice, costs 0.8-8.5 points and reverses whether rerouting beats MoNE's mean-output replacement; on two routers trained with renormalization, the trained scale wins at 50% pruning. We introduce the tilted novice, a closed-form low-rank map of the pruned expert's input whose rank-0 case is MoNE's constant. At 50% pruning it adds 1.2-1.8% parameters and gains 3.45 and 1.37 points over the constant on OLMoE and Moonlight, stable across calibration draws and largely unchanged by 4- and 3-bit quantization. No operator dominates: trained-scale rerouting is best on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and a partial copy of each pruned expert is statistically indistinguishable from the tilted novice on two models. Evaluation can change conclusions: at 25% pruning MoNE's constant keeps 92-97% of dense multiple-choice accuracy but only 5-65% of GSM8K and 0-17% of code scores, and the calibration domain moves the mask 4-9 times more than resampling. We propose a five-item reporting checklist.

papers.title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
papers.brief: 研究在两种规模的混合专家模型中比较Muon与AdamW，以路由偏置跨度衡量负载平衡难度，并通过切换路由器优化器、输入去均值和降低学习率定位原因。
papers.tldr: Muon加剧首个专家层的负载失衡，输入去均值可缓解且几乎不影响损失。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在两种规模的混合专家模型中比较Muon与AdamW，以路由偏置跨度衡量负载平衡难度，并通过切换路由器优化器、输入去均值和降低学习率定位原因。
key_points: 55M与108M活跃参数模型中，Muon使首层偏置跨度平均约翻倍
失衡源于网络其余部分使用Muon，最忙专家负载达公平份额4至7倍
前3000步输入去均值消除过载，损失几乎不变
papers.why_notable: 结果揭示优化器可通过路由输入方向影响专家负载，而非仅作用于路由器；为混合专家训练的优化器选择与失衡修正提供实证依据。
papers.abstract: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.

papers.title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
papers.brief: SphereFlow用冻结的自监督编码器将各模态映射到共享超球面，以观测模态潜变量作为流匹配起点，并用时间加权损失训练解码器适应近球面路径。
papers.tldr: 将多模态映射到共享超球面，以短程几何流补全缺失影像并改善肿瘤分割。
papers.what_it_is: SphereFlow用冻结的自监督编码器将各模态映射到共享超球面，以观测模态潜变量作为流匹配起点，并用时间加权损失训练解码器适应近球面路径。
key_points: 以观测模态潜变量替代高斯噪声，仅学习跨模态位移
证明偏离流形的最坏界与维度无关，由模态相似度控制
BraTS补全与CT-MRI转换领先，分割缩小约80%差距
papers.why_notable: 把跨模态生成转化为共享空间内的短程运输，兼顾几何约束与解码适配；不仅提升影像保真度，还明显改善下游分割。
papers.abstract: Missing modality imputation aims to synthesize unobserved modalities from observed ones. Existing methods treat each modality as living on its own latent manifold, forcing the generator to learn a long, unstructured jump between them. We present SphereFlow, which takes a fundamentally different view: by projecting all modalities into a shared hyperspherical latent space via a frozen self-supervised encoder, cross-modal imputation reduces to short-range geometric transport between nearby points on the sphere. Realizing this idea with flow matching, however, exposes two geometric conflicts: the standard Gaussian noise source is catastrophically mismatched with the unit-norm data manifold, and the linear interpolation path departs the sphere surface into a region where the decoder has no training signal. We resolve both with simple, geometry-aware modifications: replacing the noise source with the observed-modality latent so that the velocity field learns only the cross-modal displacement, and training the decoder with a time-weighted loss that extends its domain to the near-surface region traversed by the flow. We prove that this data-as-source formulation reduces the worst-case off-manifold deviation from a quantity that grows with the latent dimension to a small, dimension-independent bound governed by inter-modality similarity. Experiments on BraTS multi-modal MRI imputation and CT-MRI translation demonstrate state-of-the-art generation fidelity across all settings, while downstream brain tumor segmentation with our imputed data closes roughly eighty percent of the gap to the full-modality oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow.

papers.title: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
papers.brief: 构建城市级模拟引擎与调查基准，以统一行为时间线生成跨机构记录。模型仅通过受限接口调查，再用已知模拟事件检验其结论。
papers.tldr: 城市级模拟揭示多数模型难以可靠查案，少数前沿模型仍会误判与受骗
papers.what_it_is: 构建城市级模拟引擎与调查基准，以统一行为时间线生成跨机构记录。模型仅通过受限接口调查，再用已知模拟事件检验其结论。
key_points: Kierston模拟约12.5万居民及多源记录
KierstonBench含32类任务，测试16个模型
少数前沿模型完成多数任务，但仍受常见骗局误导
papers.why_notable: 为难以获得真实答案的调查与监控任务提供可评分环境，也揭示模型无依据指认与受骗风险，区分查案能力和可靠性。
papers.abstract: Large language models are candidates for collecting and analyzing records in criminal investigations and mass surveillance. Their capability and accuracy in this work cannot currently be measured. Real deployments lack the ground truth needed to score a model's conclusions, and no benchmark evaluates these capabilities in a simulated environment. We present Kierston, a city-scale simulation engine, and KierstonBench, a benchmark that tests these capabilities against known simulated events. Kierston models approximately 125,000 residents of Allentown, Pennsylvania, generating their daily activities and the telecommunications, financial, administrative and license-plate records that surveillance and investigative systems collect about them. These records derive from a common behavioral timeline and are distributed across sources representing separate providers. Models investigate through a restricted records interface, linking observations across sources without access to the underlying simulation. The benchmark comprises 32 task families covering record linkage, routine reconstruction, incident investigation and assessment of deceptive accounts. In an evaluation of sixteen language models, most could not perform records investigation and submitted identifications the records did not support. A small number of frontier models solved most of the tasks and abstained when evidence was insufficient. In some cases these models still fell for common deceptions and assumptions, and none replaced an investigator.

papers.title: Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses
papers.brief: 固定模型权重，将源问题实体替换产生的隐藏状态变化注入同实体的目标问题，并与输出分数直接复用对照，检验答案对数概率变化的跨问题迁移。
papers.tldr: 实体替换引发的隐藏状态变化可跨问题复用，但主要迁移关系共享效应。
papers.what_it_is: 固定模型权重，将源问题实体替换产生的隐藏状态变化注入同实体的目标问题，并与输出分数直接复用对照，检验答案对数概率变化的跨问题迁移。
key_points: 隐藏复用在模型50%深度注入对齐变化
跨关系复用使小型Qwen、Llama误差降低45%、49%
Gemma恢复BOS后误差降低58%—68%
papers.why_notable: 将实体替换的迁移效应细分为关系共享与选择性变化，揭示复用收益依赖接收问题及输入格式，为理解内部表征提供证据。
papers.abstract: With model weights fixed, we measure how much of an entity-replacement response transfers between English factual questions, beyond whether answers change. We add the hidden-state change from two source questions to a target question about the same entity, comparing the predicted log-probability shift between two relations' published answers, given known answer prefixes, with the measured one. Hidden reuse injects the aligned change at 50% depth before the target's remaining layers; direct reuse adds source output-score changes. With other-relation sources, hidden reuse removes 45% and 49% of no-change error on 0.5-1B Qwen and Llama. Gemma-2-2B removes 22% and passes one of three comparisons in plain text without its default beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token. A later protocol restoring it yields 58-68%, passing every comparison on three cohorts. Larger checkpoints, chat format and new entities show replication and format- or cohort-dependent failures. On small plain-format checkpoints, other-relation hidden reuse mainly reproduces the shift both relations' questions share, without reliably lowering relation-selective error. With target-relation sources, hidden reuse's post hoc advantage over direct reuse is 0.2-0.9 nats outside chat format, unconfirmed and not replacement-specific. The same relation-neutral change at both questions' entity tokens lowers relation-selective error more than random or other-replacement changes, indicating receiving-question dependence.

papers.title: Going Deeper With Memories
papers.brief: 提出因果多尺度字节模型，将语义压缩与字节保真分离。以可逆子带变换缩短序列，在压缩瓶颈迭代共享状态，再由注意力超分辨率解码器恢复字节分辨率。
papers.tldr: DeepMem以可逆多尺度压缩与记忆计算，提升字节级建模并降低推理开销。
papers.what_it_is: 提出因果多尺度字节模型，将语义压缩与字节保真分离。以可逆子带变换缩短序列，在压缩瓶颈迭代共享状态，再由注意力超分辨率解码器恢复字节分辨率。
key_points: 可逆子带变换配合无损载体与细节旁带保留字节身份
编码器使用快权重记忆块，瓶颈精炼计数FLOPs约少7600倍
优于匹配的字节Transformer，FLORES宏平均最佳
papers.why_notable: 它为无分词器建模提供了兼顾字节保真与压缩计算的路径，并在语言建模、多语言评测和常识任务上展示收益。
papers.abstract: Byte level language models avoid tokenizer dependence and provide universal coverage, but processing every byte at full resolution is expensive. We introduce DeepMem, a causal multiscale architecture that separates semantic compression from exact byte preservation. A learned invertible subband transform constructs a hierarchy of shorter sequences, while a lossless carrier and explicit detail sidebands preserve byte identity. Fast weight memory blocks operate along the encoder, with iterative shared state computation at the compressed bottleneck, while an attention based super resolution decoder restores byte resolution representations. DeepMem achieves stronger language modeling performance than a matched byte level Transformer on FineWeb-Edu and PG19, and obtains the best macro average performance across the evaluated FLORES languages. It also improves PIQA accuracy while remaining competitive on code modeling, multiple choice reasoning, and byte level corruption robustness. Bottleneck refinement requires approximately $7{,}600\times$ fewer counted FLOPs than equivalent full resolution reasoning, while maintaining competitive evaluation throughput.

papers.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
papers.brief: 提出金融深度研究系统的诊断回测基准，覆盖三地市场四类预测任务。结果显示历史成绩可能虚高，更严格的检索时点控制可缩小回测与实时预测差距。
papers.tldr: 提出金融深度研究系统的诊断回测基准，覆盖三地市场四类预测任务。结果显示历史成绩可能虚高，更严格的检索时点控制可缩小回测与实时预测差距。
papers.abstract: Anticipating financial outcomes requires synthesizing evolving evidence and reasoning under uncertainty, making deep research systems promising tools for forecasting. Yet evaluating forecasting ability is challenging because historical backtests may reward memorized outcomes or information retrieved after the forecast date. Live forecasting avoids direct access to realized outcomes, but feedback arrives only after events resolve. To obtain timely feedback and assess historical scores, we introduce FinForesight, a diagnostic backtesting benchmark for financial deep research systems. Across the Chinese, U.S., and Hong Kong markets, the benchmark evaluates four forecasting tasks: valuation, return ranking, event direction, and future financial fundamentals. Two capability diagnostic tasks assess counterfactual reasoning and financial calculation, scored separately from forecasting performance. Our harness-compatible framework restricts retrieved evidence to information available at the forecast date. We compare pretraining-era, resolved post-cutoff, and live evaluations to test whether controlled backtests approximate future performance. Pretraining-era scores exceed post-cutoff scores in most temporal comparisons, and stronger retrieval controls narrow the gap between post-cutoff backtests and live results. Forecasting attribution and robustness analyses reveal how scores respond to retrieval policy and how predictions respond to prompt rewrites and numerical perturbations. The code and benchmark data are publicly available.

papers.title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
papers.brief: 提出TNAS诊断并引导视觉攻击，在保持VLA解释逐字不变时改变动作；驾驶场景中新碰撞率达52.6%，表明仅监控解释不足以保障安全。
papers.tldr: 提出TNAS诊断并引导视觉攻击，在保持VLA解释逐字不变时改变动作；驾驶场景中新碰撞率达52.6%，表明仅监控解释不足以保障安全。
papers.abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.

papers.title: Robots in the City: Persona-Based Perceptions of Urban Robots
papers.brief: 研究用合成人设驱动多模态模型，并与人类比较城市机器人安全感判断。模型偏好无机器人街道，夜间更接受机器人，但对人形机器人的判断与人类有明显差异。
papers.tldr: 研究用合成人设驱动多模态模型，并与人类比较城市机器人安全感判断。模型偏好无机器人街道，夜间更接受机器人，但对人形机器人的判断与人类有明显差异。
papers.abstract: Pedestrians increasingly encounter robots in urban public spaces without interacting with them, but how robots change the perceived safety of a street remains unclear. We examine how robot presence and type affect perceived safety across urban contexts. We generate 18 images of Seoul streets that vary in time of day, road class, and robot condition (no robot, a delivery robot, or a humanoid). Two multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B, each conditioned on 500 synthetic personas, choose the safer image in each pair, and 25 human respondents complete the same task. Both models prefer streets without robots and favor the delivery robot over the humanoid. Robots are chosen more often at night and less often by older personas, whereas road class has smaller effects. In the model rationales, the delivery robot appears as a physical obstacle, whereas the humanoid appears as either a threat or a source of protection. Like humans, both models chose robots more often at night, but chose the humanoid over the delivery robot far less often, and Gemma showed a night effect for the humanoid about three times that of humans. These results show that the effect of a robot on perceived safety depends on when it appears, and that persona-conditioned MLLMs capture only part of human judgments.

papers.title: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.brief: 提出免训练的模态感知专家剪枝，区分视觉与文本的重要性信号。多数多模态基准优于现有剪枝方法，约58GB模型压缩后可装入单张40GB显卡。
papers.tldr: 提出免训练的模态感知专家剪枝，区分视觉与文本的重要性信号。多数多模态基准优于现有剪枝方法，约58GB模型压缩后可装入单张40GB显卡。
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to scale capacity efficiently, but expert parameters dominate memory even though only a few experts are activated per token: they account for over 90% of model size in modern MoE-MLLMs (e.g., 54 GB out of about 58 GB in BF16 for InternVL3.5-30B-A3B and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B). Expert pruning has emerged as an effective compression strategy, but existing methods aggregate importance uniformly across tokens, ignoring that the same expert may serve different roles for vision versus language processing. To address this, we propose MAEP (Modality-Aware Expert Pruning), a training-free framework that decomposes expert importance by modality in a single forward pass. MAEP introduces (1) Delta-H Output ($ΔH$), a redistribution-aware metric measuring the MoE output change when an expert is removed, and (2) low-attention vision tokens as a vision-side pruning signal that is dataset-stable: its expert-importance ranking remains stable across different datasets. Text-side importance serves as a preservation signal while vision-side importance serves as a pruning signal, and experts are ranked globally across layers. Experiments on three MoE-based MLLMs across multimodal and text benchmarks show that MAEP outperforms modality-agnostic baselines on the majority of multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive on text-only tasks, reducing the BF16 expert weight footprint by about 27 GB (about 47% of total memory) so that the full weight footprint of an approximately 58 GB model fits within a single 40 GB GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/nota-github/MAEP.

papers.title: Routes of Reasoning: Reading and Reshaping Test-Time Compute in MoE Models
papers.brief: 利用MoE路由信号识别推理行为，并在推理时免训练地调整专家分数以抑制过度思考；生成词元中位数减少30.4%，准确率下降不超过0.5个百分点。
papers.tldr: 利用MoE路由信号识别推理行为，并在推理时免训练地调整专家分数以抑制过度思考；生成词元中位数减少30.4%，准确率下降不超过0.5个百分点。
papers.abstract: Reasoning models allocate test-time compute across distinct behaviors such as planning, deriving, and verifying. However, models frequently "overthink," continuing to verify and re-derive long after finding a correct answer. This wastes expensive compute and can even degrade performance. Existing interventions, such as token budgets or steering, primarily regulate reasoning duration rather than targeting specific behaviors. In this work, we demonstrate that Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers provide a natural, training-free interface for behavioral control. We first split reasoning traces into sentence-level segments and label each with one of six reasoning behaviors (planning, execution, restatement, fact, reflection, and conclusion), so that every token carries the behavior of its segment. Linear probes on router logits predict this label nearly as well as probes on the residual stream, the model's full hidden state and the standard target for probing, while using about half as many features. These signals generalize: experts associated with a reasoning behavior on one dataset predict the same behavior on the others, across six datasets spanning five domains (math, code, science, knowledge, and commonsense). Building on this, we selectively edit expert router scores during inference to curb overthinking. Across four models and four benchmarks, this intervention reduces the number of generated tokens by a median of 30.4% (and up to 63.3%). Crucially, it encourages the model to stop once the problem is solved, rather than skipping essential reasoning steps. Accuracy never drops by more than 0.5 percentage points, and frequently improves. Ultimately, MoE routing offers both an interpretable lens into reasoning states and a lightweight mechanism for optimizing test-time compute.

papers.title: Selective, Risk-Controlled Emotion Forecasting in Conversation: From a Persistence Barrier to Departure Detection with Conformal Guarantees
papers.brief: 研究发现对话情绪数值预测难超越状态持续基线，转向预测偏离时机；共形风险控制在全部测试配置中达标，但困难语料上需大量弃答。
papers.tldr: 研究发现对话情绪数值预测难超越状态持续基线，转向预测偏离时机；共形风险控制在全部测试配置中达标，但困难语料上需大量弃答。
papers.abstract: Forecasting emotion in conversation is increasingly framed as predicting the next emotional state's value. We show this targets a hard quantity in a state-observed testbed and propose a learnable, deployable reformulation instead. On valence-arousal-dominance trajectories from a dyadic corpus, repeating a speaker's own previous state sets a persistence baseline that no frozen-encoder correction meaningfully improves upon and a state-space filter exceeds; the floor requires the historical state to be observed, since an estimated anchor collapses persistence below a direct forecaster. What survives is the timing of a departure from persistence, learnable on three of four corpora and near chance on the highest-base-rate corpus, a negative result we report. We recast the task as selective departure forecasting: a lead-time-weighted metric with a leakage protocol, and commitment policies whose best choice switches with the departure rate. A dialogue-level conformal risk control bounds the expected loss of committed predictions, meeting the target in all twelve configurations tested, though the guarantee is bought through abstention, with coverage and alarm recall falling sharply on the hardest corpus. One tested language model's confidence fails as a ranking signal where another succeeds, a model-dependent failure not yet attributable to family versus scale. Code and result logs are available from the corresponding author upon request.

papers.title: Information-Matched Auditing of Conversational Emotion-Shift Forecasting: A Leakage-Safe Evaluation Protocol
papers.brief: 提出信息匹配、无泄漏的对话情绪转变预测评估协议；四个语料实验显示，模型优势取决于基线可用信息，DailyDialog上的提升最稳健。
papers.tldr: 提出信息匹配、无泄漏的对话情绪转变预测评估协议；四个语料实验显示，模型优势取决于基线可用信息，DailyDialog上的提升最稳健。
papers.abstract: Comparisons in conversational emotion-shift forecasting are easily distorted when a learned model receives rich features but its transition baseline is given a noisy or unavailable current-emotion label, when hyperparameter budgets differ, or when target-turn information enters the representation. We present an information-matched, leakage-safe auditing protocol that closes these gaps with an explicit commitment point, executable causality tests, equal four-configuration validation searches, and seed-dialogue-aware inference. Applying it to six causal model families on four text corpora and two feature-source sensitivity configurations shows that a deployable train-only current-emotion classifier feeding the transition baseline yields a different verdict than an oracle diagnostic where both sides receive gold current emotion. Under the deployable condition, learned models improve over the predicted-label baseline on all four primary corpora; DailyDialog gains are large and survive a 72-comparison Holm correction (best ROC-AUC gain = +0.167, adjusted p=.0144). Under matched gold information, the baseline remains competitive on IEMOCAP and stronger on MELD, while every model retains a large DailyDialog advantage. We additionally report precision-recall AUC, calibration, a strictly utterance-local feature control, same-person self-shift forecasting, and a future-access dose-response test. An eight-item leakage checklist accompanies the protocol. Code, raw seed predictions, and reporting artifacts are available from the corresponding author upon request.

papers.title: When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?
papers.brief: 研究知识图谱审计中置信度提升为何未必改善纠错，提出预算覆盖模型；联合规划比错误率与影响范围排序少留约4个百分点错误，揭示结构依赖的重要性。
papers.tldr: 研究知识图谱审计中置信度提升为何未必改善纠错，提出预算覆盖模型；联合规划比错误率与影响范围排序少留约4个百分点错误，揭示结构依赖的重要性。
papers.abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $Δ^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.

papers.title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
papers.brief: 提出购物建议评测基准CARTBench，用真实多轮需求与案例评分细则评估十个模型；结果显示核心要求达标不等于高质量建议，产品证据与未决需求处理仍薄弱。
papers.tldr: 提出购物建议评测基准CARTBench，用真实多轮需求与案例评分细则评估十个模型；结果显示核心要求达标不等于高质量建议，产品证据与未决需求处理仍薄弱。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench.
